mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined in the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0 percentage points, it indicates a weakening labor market that signals potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-FED hiking cycle regime (where the federal funds rate has risen by at least 100 basis points over the past 12 months), a subsequent decline in the federal funds rate signals the end of tightening and the start of easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances in the post-hiking regime when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces overall economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240.0, it indicates elevated inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
